packageRules.description: pnpm refuses packages under a day old (its minimumReleaseAge), so Renovate waits as long: otherwise its PRs fail to install.
Third-party actions hold the deploy credentials, so they're pinned to a commit; Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags.
Azure Functions runs the checker on Node 22 (Flex Consumption's newest): keep it, and its types, there until Azure offers a newer one.
